sections.title: We and you (plural)
sections.content: To invite someone, use *mi* (we): *Gyakorolunk együtt?* (Shall we practise together?) The *mi* form ends in *-unk* or *-ünk*: *beszélünk, tanulunk, gyakorolunk*. To ask two or more people, use *ti*: *Ti beszéltek angolul?* The *ti* form ends in *-tok / -tek / -otok*: *beszéltek, tanultok, gyakoroltok*. For *ők*: *beszélnek, tanulnak, gyakorolnak*.

sections.title: Offering and accepting
sections.content: *Segítesz?* asks one friend for help. Answer with *Persze!* or *Igen, segítek.* End a good exchange with praise: *Ügyes vagy!* (Well done!).
*Beszéltek* is the *ti* form of *beszél*. Use it only to ask more than one person; for one friend, use *beszélsz*.
